artworks.title: Marie de Medici
artworks.description: The image shows a seated woman in a chair, looking noble. She has distinctive facial features and short curly hair. She wears a detailed gown with voluminous sleeves and a high collar, with a flower on her chest. She holds a bouquet of flowers or herbs and next to her on a table is a crown. The background includes a curtain and ornate illustrations. Circular medallions with scenes and symbols are also present.

artworks.title: Robert Melunius
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man with a high forehead, prominent arched eyebrows, deep-set eyes, a prominent nose, and a full mustache and beard. His hair is closely cropped and wavy, revealing a receding hairline. He is wearing a ruffled collar and a dark doublet typical of the Renaissance period. The background has concentric oval lines. Below the portrait, there is text identifying the subject as "ROBERTVS MELVINVS RVBASII MARCH. MAGISTER EQVIT."

artworks.title: Franciscus de Mendosa
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man facing forward but slightly turned to the side. His pose is upright with his head turned slightly towards his left shoulder. He has a distinctive facial appearance characterized by a prominent high forehead, arched eyebrows, and deep-set eyes. He has a full beard and a well-groomed mustache that curves upwards. His hair is short with a noticeable central peak. The man is wearing an ornate jacket with a high, ruffled collar and elaborate embroidery, fastened with buttons down the front. The background features a patterned design forming an oval frame, with text written around it.

artworks.title: Franciscus de Mendoza
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man from the waist up, facing forward. He has a high forehead, a long straight nose, a well-defined jawline with a full beard, and wavy hair flowing around his shoulders. He is dressed in elaborate armor with intricate details and patterns, and wears a sash diagonally across his chest. The background features a textured, circular frame, with text surrounding the engraving at the top and bottom.

artworks.title: Admiral Jan Cornelius Meppel of Holland
artworks.artist: Reinier van Persyn after Christoffel Pierson
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing and facing the viewer, with his left elbow propped on a table. He has wavy, shoulder-length hair and a tidy mustache. His attire includes a dark garment with elaborate embroidery along the edges and wide sleeves, as well as a large decorative chain draped around his shoulders. His hand rests on the table, which holds a helmet and other maritime symbols. The background displays an intricate carving above the man's head, as well as a maritime scene with ships sailing in the ocean under a cloudy sky. The lower part of the image contains textual inscriptions detailing the person's identity and accomplishments.

artworks.title: Gerard Mercator
artworks.description: The portrait features an older male figure, presented from the waist up, positioned seated with his upper body slightly turned to the right. He has a long, full beard and wears a black hat on his head, with his hair partially visible as it peeks from underneath. His facial features include a pronounced, long nose and deep-set eyes. The figure is dressed in a dark purple garment with a white collar, accented by a darker vest or jacket. His right hand is holding a measuring compass tool, and his left arm rests on a globe. In the background, the image is framed by a blue oval border with Latin text encircling the portrait. The entire portrait is set against a textured, brownish-beige paper with additional decorative scrollwork and text beneath the image. A poem or text written in Latin is below the image.

artworks.title: Joannes van Meurs, Dutch Classical Scholar
artworks.description: The image depicts an engraving of a man shown from the chest upwards and slightly turned so that his right shoulder is closer to the viewer. The man has a calm expression with defined facial features including strong eyebrows, rounded cheeks, and a pointed goatee. He has a connected mustache and goatee, as well as short cropped hair. The man is dressed in intricately patterned clothing with a high, wide collar and a buttoned vest or jacket. Surrounding him is an oval frame with decorative lines, and above him is text that reads "ÆTERNitatem cogita," while below is the inscription "IOANNES MEURSIUS I.C. ET HISTORIÆ GRÆCÆ PROFESS." The background of the image is filled with densely hatched lines for depth and contrast.

artworks.title: Johannes Meursius, Historian
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man showing his head and upper torso. He is positioned facing slightly to the side, looking directly at the viewer. The man has a full beard and mustache, with his hair appearing short and slightly wavy. His facial features include a high forehead and an expression that conveys a sense of dignity. He is wearing a dark-colored coat with a high, elaborate white ruff collar that frames his face distinctly. Around his neck, he wears a chain with a circular medallion. The portrait is set in an ornate oval frame that includes inscriptions around it. The background of the portrait appears to be a plain textured paper.

artworks.title: Johannes Meursius, Historian
artworks.description: The image depicts a man with a beard and mustache, shown from the chest up. He is facing forward but slightly turned to his left. He is dressed in a dark garment with a large lace ruff around his neck. He wears a chain with a medallion. The background features an elaborate frame with swirling designs and text.

artworks.title: Petrus Molineus
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of a man's upper body, positioned slightly turned to his left. He has a high forehead with receding hairline, closely cropped hair, defined brow, deep-set eyes, straight nose, short beard with a mustache. He wears attire with a high, wide collar, ornate patterns along the shoulders, and decorative buttons down the front. The background features intricately shaded oval framing, text around the inner frame, and a small inscription at the bottom.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man in an Oval with Cupids Decoration
artworks.description: This engraving depicts the upper torso of a person within an ornate oval frame. The person has a distinguished facial expression, characterized by a pronounced hairline and a finely groomed, short beard. The individual has short, receding hair and is dressed in formal attire with a high-collared shirt and a dark robe adorned with a decorative chain around the neck. Surrounding the figure are allegorical cherubs; one holds a wreath above the head while others interact with decorative elements. The background features intricate designs, including drapery and a cartouche with an inscription at the bottom. The overall aesthetic conveys a sense of formality and stature.

artworks.title: Ann, Wife of James Scott, Duke of Monmouth and Buccleuch
artworks.artist: Pieter Schenck I after Sir Godfrey Kneller
artworks.description: The image is an oval portrait showing the upper body of a woman titled "The Dutches of Monmouth." She is positioned facing forward with her head slightly turned to the viewer's left. Her facial features include arched eyebrows, large eyes, and a small, defined mouth. She has curly hair, styled with volume around the crown and falling to her shoulders, with a few curls framing her face. The woman is wearing an elaborate garment, featuring patterned fabric with decorative bows on the sleeves and a low-cut neckline adorned with what appears to be a brooch. Draped over her shoulders is a sheer scarf or veil. The background is a textured grayscale, providing a neutral contrast to her dark attire, and the bottom part of the image includes the title and artist's information written in elegant script.

artworks.title: James, Duke of Monmouth and Buccleuch
artworks.artist: Abraham Blooteling after Sir Peter Lely
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man depicted from the waist up. He is positioned in a seated posture, with his body turned slightly to one side while his head faces forward. The man has long, voluminous curly hair that cascades down around his shoulders, and he possesses distinct facial features with a calm expression. He is wearing opulent clothing, consisting of a richly decorated garment with large lace ruffles at the collar and cuffs, and adorned with a prominent necklace or chain featuring intricate designs. On his left arm is an emblem with the word "JOHNSON" visible. The man’s right hand rests on a fabric surface, while his left hand hangs relaxed by his side. The background includes a large, solid architectural column.

artworks.title: James Montagu, Bishop of Winchester
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image shows an upper body engraving of a man in a seated position. He has a bearded face, defined cheekbones, a prominent nose, and short hair beneath a cap. He is dressed in formal attire typical of the era, with a high, ruffled collar and a dark cloak-like garment over a lighter inner garment. In his left hand, he holds an object that appears to be a book or paper. The background includes a column, creating a sense of setting that suggests an indoor environment.

artworks.title: James Graham, First Marquess of Montrose
artworks.description: The image depicts a man in armor, visible from the upper half of his body. The man is standing with his head turned slightly to the left, facing the viewer. He has an oval face, a mustache, and long, wavy hair. He wears a suit of armor including a chest plate and shoulder guards. There is a coat of arms on the upper left and a decorative element resembling a helmet with an animal, potentially a lion, on the upper right. The background is textured with parallel horizontal lines. Below the image is text outlining the titles and positions of "Iames Marquesses of Montrose" in Scotland.

artworks.title: James Graham, First Marquess of Montrose
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person from the upper half. The person faces forward with a slight turn to the right, holding a staff in their right hand with their left arm resting on a ledge. They have a serious expression with a slight smile, a mustache, and long, curly hair past their shoulders. The person is depicted wearing armor, a large belt, and a sash on their torso. The background has lined engravings, and the portrait is within a framed border. There is an inscription at the bottom with text detailing the person's titles and the name of the engraver.

artworks.title: Sir John Moore
artworks.artist: James MacArdell after Sir Peter Lely
artworks.description: The image depicts a man sitting in an armchair. He has long hair, a serious expression, and is wearing a robe with fur trim, a patterned vest, and a lace cravat. There is a chain draped over his shoulders, and the chair has floral patterns. In the background, there is a tapestry and a crown on a pedestal.

artworks.title: Alexander Morus
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man from the waist up, seated in a slightly turned position. He has a full face with a mustache and a small goatee, shoulder-length curly hair, and is wearing a traditional 17th-century outfit with a dark robe featuring a white collar and cuffs. His right hand is resting on his chest while his left hand is placed on what looks like the edge of a table or a chest covered with a patterned cloth. There are no visible pieces of jewelry on him, nor any objects he appears to be holding. The background includes draped curtains on the left and a detailed wall surface to the right. Text beneath the image contextualizes the portrait.

artworks.title: Alexander More
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a seated pose from the waist up. He has one hand resting on a surface with a patterned cloth and the other hand on his chest. He has a mustache, a small pointed beard, wide eyes, wavy shoulder-length hair, and is dressed in period-appropriate attire with a wide-collared shirt and a dark cloak or gown. The background features columns and elegant drapery, suggesting a refined environment.

artworks.title: John More, Rector of Saint Andrew's, Norwich
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: This is a portrait of a man's upper body. The man is facing slightly to his right, with his gaze directed towards the viewer. He has a full beard and mustache, a prominent nose, deep-set eyes, and short hair mostly covered by a wide-brimmed hat. He is wearing a coat with a fur collar. There is a crosshatch pattern in the background. Below the portrait is text likely identifying the person.

artworks.title: Sir Thomas More
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body portrait of a man seated facing to the right. His facial features are notable for their solemn expression, with wrinkles visible on his forehead, deep-set eyes, and a defined nose. The man is wearing a fur-trimmed robe, and a decorative flower-shaped brooch on the left side of his chest. His hair is mostly covered by a dark, flat hat typical of the period, with only a slight fringe visible. The background is a textured pattern. Below the portrait, there is a text providing information about the person depicted, including his name, "Thomas Morus."

artworks.title: Sir Thomas More, Lord Chancellor
artworks.description: The image is a detailed, historical engraving of a man from the waist up. He is seated, facing slightly to the right, with his hands in front of him. One hand holds a scroll. The man has a serious expression, straight nose, prominent chin, and his eyes are looking to the right. He wears a cap, and his clothing includes a fur-lined robe, an elaborate chain of office on his shoulders, and an ornate badge at the front. Additional elements in the image include a scroll, a coat of arms or emblem, two small birds, and decorative designs in the background. Surrounding the image is Latin text.

artworks.title: Sir Thomas More, Lord Chacellor
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man with distinct facial features, seated and slightly turned to the side. He wears a robe with a fur-trimmed collar and holds a rolled-up scroll in his left hand while pointing to it with his right hand. Below the portrait is text that identifies him.

artworks.title: Balthasar Moretus of Antwerp
artworks.description: The portrait shows an upper-body view of a man seated in profile, facing to the right of the image. He has a refined facial profile with a mustache and a short beard, and his hair is neatly combed and short. He wears a garment with a large, ornate ruffled collar and what appears to be a cloak with visible folds and intricate detailing. The man’s hands are visible, resting on a surface that looks like a stack of books, with some decorative elements visible on the book covers. In the background, a pattern of vertical lines suggests a textured wall that adds depth to the engraving. There is text below the image with information, presumably about the man, including his name and some Latin inscriptions.
